d:
I can't believe I actually did this. It was without question, the scariest experience of my life, and I can officially say that I am now a believer in ghosts and spirits. Huge thank you to my friends for inviting me down here and showing me the ropes, and to for keeping me sane.
The paranormal is a new space for me, so if you enjoyed this story and want to see more of it, please let me know in the comments down below! Your feedback is greatly appreciated.
I wrote a book called JUST GO, with exclusive travel stories & tips to inspire your next adventures!
